important.title: Important
important.description: Agents must comply with legislation and ethical standards. We reserve the right to reject any agent that may harm users.

cost.question: How much does it cost to list an agent?
cost.answer: Listing agents on PrimeAgents is free. We only take a commission from paid agents upon sale.

edit.question: Can I edit an agent after publication?
edit.answer: Yes, you can update information about your agent. Significant changes may require re-moderation.

rejected.question: What to do if an agent was rejected?
rejected.answer: You will receive detailed comments about rejection reasons. Fix the indicated issues and resubmit.

promote.question: How to promote my agent?
promote.answer: Quality description, screenshots, active user interaction, and regular updates help increase agent popularity.

languages.question: Are agents in other languages supported?
languages.answer: Yes, we accept agents in any languages. We recommend providing descriptions in English or Russian for better accessibility.

support.question: How to contact support?
support.answer: You can write to us at support@primeagents.com or use the feedback form on the site.
